activityId.description: Known Aura catalog activity id (e.g. "exercise"). Provide exactly one of activityId or taskTitle.

dailyRhythm.description: Optional explicit work hours. When omitted, no Daily Rhythm preference is applied.

dateRange.description: Explicit local date range to search (inclusive). Mutually exclusive with horizon.

end.description: Local calendar date in the supplied timezone, YYYY-MM-DD.

start.description: Local calendar date in the supplied timezone, YYYY-MM-DD.

horizon.description: Relative search window, resolved against referenceTime in the supplied timezone. Defaults to TODAY when neither horizon nor dateRange is given.

limit.description: Maximum candidates to return (1-10). Defaults to 3.

location.description: Coordinates the Panchangam windows are computed for. Not geocoded, not inferred.

referenceTime.description: "Now" for the search. Relative horizons (TODAY, TOMORROW, ...) are resolved from it and exclude times before it. An explicit dateRange is searched as given, so a past dateRange returns past times. Defaults to the server clock at call time; supply it for reproducible results.

taskTitle.description: Free-text activity, classified by Aura's existing activity classifier (e.g. "Go for a run"). Provide exactly one of activityId or taskTitle.

timePreference.description: Optional part-of-day preference. Defaults to ANY.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret every local date/time (e.g. "Asia/Kolkata").
